# DropSpace v0.2.0-preview.6 — Release consistency and Stable candidate

<!-- update-summary: Release metadata now stays consistent across the App, GitHub Release, official website API, checksums, and documentation. This is the final v0.2.0 Stable candidate; Smart drag behavior is unchanged. -->

This Preview closes the remaining release-consistency gaps before v0.2.0 Stable. Smart drag behavior, the single Dynamic Island interface, local data handling, and Stable/Preview selection are unchanged.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/

## Release reliability

- `update-manifest.json` now derives its user-visible summary from the matching release notes instead of an old hard-coded Preview description.
- CI rejects releases when `RELEASE_VERSION`, release notes, README, ROADMAP, or the manifest summary disagree.
- Every publication performs an end-to-end check of the GitHub Release, all five public assets, checksums, manifest, official website API, and Stable website state when applicable.
- Disposable GitHub Actions artifacts now have explicit short retention periods; public GitHub Release assets remain unchanged.
- Documentation now reflects the current Preview and the Dynamic-Island-only product.

## Stable candidate

- The user-confirmed Smart drag detector remains unchanged.
- Installer, portable EXE, unsigned MSIX, update channels, schema version 1, GitHub Pages authority, and GitHub Releases fallback remain compatible.
- This build is the final release-chain rehearsal before the separately built v0.2.0 Stable release.

## 中文说明

- 修复版本号、Release Notes、README、ROADMAP、更新 Manifest 与官网 API 之间可能不一致的问题。
- 每次发布后自动核对 GitHub Release、五个公开资产、SHA-256、Manifest 和官网 API。
- 智能检测与灵动岛行为保持不变，本版本作为 v0.2.0 Stable 的最终候选版。
